onion_skin: Open the Onion Skin manager when you want to compare a pose with nearby frames without leaving the camera view.
Add the character meshes, enable onion skins, then scrub through the poses you want to compare.
Right-click for a quick change between shaded, shape, and outline views.

onion_skin.label: onionSkinRenderer
onion_skin.text: Based on the original tool onionSkinRenderer by Christoph Lendenfeld.

toggle: Show onion skins in the viewport while checking spacing, silhouettes, and arcs.
add_selection: Add the selected character meshes or props to the onion skin view.
clear_buffer: Refresh the onion images after changing a pose, camera, material, or display setting.
draw_behind: Keep old and upcoming poses behind the current pose so the active silhouette stays easy to read.
auto_clear: Refresh stored onion images automatically after moving the camera.
stay_on_top: Keep the manager above Maya while comparing and adjusting poses.
neighbor_keys: Use keyed poses when checking timing during blocking and polish.
ghost_inbetweens: Add faint samples between the current pose and the nearest key ghosts, to check spacing without keying every frame.
auto_update: Automatically rebake ghosts after a pose changes instead of waiting for you to scrub back over that frame. See Performance for how eagerly it catches up.
past_color: Choose the color used for poses before the current frame.
future_color: Choose the color used for poses after the current frame.
held_color: Choose the color used for poses held at a specific frame.
